title: Well woven light blue rug
text: Well woven light blue rug. It's rolled around a heavy cardboard tubing but it still won't lay flat. I really DON'T like the prominent black features since I ordered a light blue with pink rug for a master bedroom. I put it on a 3 season room now since it won't work for my master.

product_metadata.title: Well Woven Argonne Grey Machine Washable Vintage Style Updated Classic Distresseed Gabbeh Area Rug (5'3" x 7'3")
features: A sophisticated color palette anchored by dusty grey and beige. Accents of pink, charcoal, and ivory mingle with the distresseed pattern to produce a lovingly well-worn look.
Machine washable for easy cleaning. Air dry flat.
Flat, shed free polyester chenille upper with a recycled cotton backing that's safe for wood floors.

Rug arrives factory rolled, may have creases from packaging and storage. Normally flattens within 5-7 days. Expedite by rolling, pattern side up, and massaging creases to loosen them. Laying out in a sunny room helps further loosen the backing.
